change_from_prior_pilots.action: runtime_probe_repair_mode=always_withhold_repair: every G0 repair action is explicitly abstained while coordinate actions still consume their immutable Phase1 candidate
change_from_prior_pilots.rationale: exp_022 (hard repair), exp_023 (soft blend), exp_024 (boundary-gated blend) all vary writeback strength/shape while keeping the premise that probe-utility-gated repair should happen. exp_023's relation_impact_report.json shows log(probe_utility/threshold) coefficient on immediate credit is -0.0362 (negative), and the high-utility/nonboundary zone had WORSE mean credit (-3.40%) than the low-utility/boundary zone (-1.03%). This is evidence the utility signal's direction, not just its calibration, may be wrong. This pilot tests the null: does gated repair add value at all, independent of writeback strength?
change_from_prior_pilots.decision_rule: compare only against fresh post-G0 1000-dimensional runs; pre-G0 exp_022/023 artifacts are excluded

controls.interpretation: R4 is the conforming-overlap control; any catastrophic loss is a hard warning

hypotheses.H1: every repair action is authorized but records repair_writeback_withheld instead of consuming shared values
hypotheses.H2: coordinate actions remain exact and one-shot
hypotheses.falsification_target: compare exp_025 with fresh post-G0 exp_024 or a fresh hard-repair control before making an action-family claim
